Presenting to you my dream lipstick💄… Our Hydra Creme Lipstick!!! I’ve always wanted that perfect blend of color and hydration in my lipstick. On set I used to mix lip balm into my lipstick to get that perfect consistency. So we set off to create the perfect formula. It took some time… but we got there! It’s exactly like the name suggests- hydrating, creamy and luxurious plus enriched with hyaluronic acid and lychee extract. 
Wearing my current favourite shade in panache.
